terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.body: TruckSOS connects broken-down truck carriers with available mechanics. The app facilitates contact; price, repair and payment are agreed directly between carrier and mechanic. We may suspend accounts that post false listings or abusive content.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We collect account data (name, email, phone, role) and the content you publish (listings, photos, messages, reviews). Your phone number is visible only to a mechanic you have an open conversation with. Your profile photo is visible to other signed-in users. Data is kept while your account is active.
